Movies in the Park

Thank you to everyone who joined us for Movies in the Park! It was great to see the community fill Creekside Park each Friday with blankets, lawn chairs, family, and friends for a month of movies under the stars.

Movies in the Park will return in August 2027, with the movie lineup and event details available in summer 2027.

FAQs

When do the movies start?
Movies start at 8 p.m.

What do I bring?
We recommend a blanket or lawn chair for your comfort, but nothing is required.

Can I bring my dog?
